message:
The ASAN runtime is not available. Let me check if GCC's ASAN works, or if I should use a different approach. Let me check what sanitizer runtimes are available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'find /usr -name "*asan*" 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; ls /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/*/libasan* 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; gcc -fsanitize=address -o /tmp/test_asan /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "GCC ASAN works" || echo "GCC ASAN failed"'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
